import React from "react"; import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; import Navbar from "../components/navbar"; import "../style.css"; function About() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const highlights = [ { label: "Years of Service", value: "5+", icon: "bi-clock-history" }, { label: "Happy Guests", value: "2,000+", icon: "bi-emoji-smile-fill" }, { label: "Events Hosted", value: "300+", icon: "bi-balloon-heart-fill" }, { label: "Awards & Recognition", value: "8", icon: "bi-trophy-fill" }, ]; const values = [ { icon: "bi-shield-check", title: "Privacy & Safety", desc: "Your comfort and security are our top priority at all times." }, { icon: "bi-gem", title: "Luxury & Quality", desc: "Only the finest amenities and experiences make it through our doors." }, { icon: "bi-heart-fill", title: "Warm Hospitality", desc: "Every guest is treated like family — with care, respect, and joy." }, { icon: "bi-leaf", title: "Eco-Conscious", desc: "We are committed to sustainable practices to protect our environment." }, ]; const team = [ { name: "", role: "", icon: "bi-person-badge-fill", desc: "" }, { name: "", role: "", icon: "bi-person-hearts", desc: "." }, { name: "", role: "", icon: "bi-calendar2-heart-fill", desc: "" }, ]; return (
{/* ── Hero ── */}
VILLA TJEOZABEL · BIÑAN CITY

About Us

A sanctuary of luxury, privacy, and unforgettable memories.

{/* ── Our Story ── */}

Our Story

From a humble dream to a premier destination in Biñan City, discover how Villa Tjeozabel came to life.

Villa Tjeozabel was born from a dream — to create a private haven where families, couples, and friends could escape the noise of the city and immerse themselves in comfort and joy.

Nestled in Biñan City, our villa offers a seamless blend of modern luxury and warm Filipino hospitality. From our sparkling private pools to elegantly designed rooms and versatile event spaces, every corner is crafted with care and intention.

{/* ── Villa at a Glance ── */}

{h.label}
